title: Double capture
violates: A hold is captured at most once, so the merchant gains no more than the hold's amount: `merchant″ − merchant ≤ h`.
because: The capture rule never looks at the hold's status, so one hold can be captured twice. The patch `held ≥ h` reads the pooled balance, so it stops this instance and not the class.
class: a step that can be applied twice because nothing records that it happened

cured_by.text: Capture a hold only while its status is `HELD`, and set the status to `CAPTURED`. With that guard the at-most-once query has no witness, whatever else is held.

also.caption: The patch `held ≥ h`, with other holds in the pool, still has a witness.
With the status guard the query has no witness.
